channel.title: Bryan Barrows — Identity security, made understandable
channel.description: Essays and notes on identity security, drawn from real building.

item.title: PHP2Shell: the identity angle everyone's missing
item.description: Wiz showed PHP worker memory — passwords, tokens, API keys — readable without code execution. In an identity context, memory disclosure IS the breach. Plus what to tell your CISO this week.

item.title: I broke ID-JAG five ways (so you don't have to)
item.description: Okta's XAA sandbox shows the happy path in 30 seconds. The happy path doesn't teach you where enforcement lives. Five interactive failures — expired grants, wrong audiences, overreach, tampering, replays — and the two-places pattern that ends most debugging sessions.
